measure.measure_definition: Apnea–hypopnea index based on the 4% oxygen-desaturation hypopnea rule (AHI4), measured by polysomnography in events per hour of sleep. The same quantity is assessed at baseline and week 26. Arithmetic summaries/changes and model-estimated geometric-mean percentage reductions are distinct statistical summaries, retained in separate result rows.
measure.measure_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) with the 4% oxygen-desaturation hypopnea rule (reported as AHI4)

measure.measure_definition: Oxygen desaturation index based on 3% oxygen desaturation, assessed by overnight polysomnography and reported as events per hour. Baseline and week-26 observed summaries, LS mean changes and the treatment difference refer to this same clinical quantity in the primary ITT analysis.

PROMIS-Fatigue T-score from the eight-item questionnaire; higher T-scores indicate greater fatigue. Assessed at baseline and weeks 4, 13 and 26. Baseline and week-26 observed means and the primary ITT change/contrast quantify the same patient-reported fatigue measure.
